# gezor_current_identity (Data Source)

The service account behind the API token and what it can do in a workspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gezor_current_identity" "me" {}

output "token_permissions" {
  value = data.gezor_current_identity.me.permissions
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `workspace` (String) Workspace id or slug. Defaults to the provider's `workspace`.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) Service account name.
- `organization_id` (String)
- `organization_name` (String)
- `permissions` (Set of String)
- `role` (String)
- `user_id` (String) Service account user id.
- `workspace_id` (String)
- `workspace_name` (String)
- `workspace_slug` (String)
